correctness.rationale: The 2024 publisher full PDF Proposition3.3 requires 0<lambda<1, lambda(||T_phi||+||T_psi||)<=A_phi/2 ||K-dagger||^-2, and synthesis difference norm<=lambda. For K=P_e1 on C2, g=e1+a e2, h=e1-a e2, families phi=(g,h), psi=(h,g), and 0<a<=1/8, each analysis energy is 2|x|^2+2a^2|y|^2, so A=B=2 are admissible K-frame bounds. The synthesis matrices have norm sqrt2, difference norm 2sqrt2 a. Set lambda=2sqrt2 a (<1), then lambda(2sqrt2)=8a<=1=(A_phi/2)||K-dagger||^-2. The weave phi1 and psi2 consists of g,g, annihilates f=-a e1+e2 while ||K*f||^2=a^2>0. All hypotheses hold and the theorem conclusion fails for arbitrarily small norm perturbation. The source proof illegitimately converts an ambient ||f||^2 term to ||K-dagger||^2||K*f||^2 for unrestricted f, although the lower inverse estimate holds only on R(K). With all atoms in R(K), projecting f to R(K) repairs the same type of estimate; sufficiency only.
